Step 3 darkness: minimum gap between the two darkness indices to decide. 0.0 = the darkest end is retained unconditionally (version of 4 October 2026).
Number of resampling points of the width-aligned medial axis.
Number of perpendicular cuts read from each end for the darkness index.
Abscissa window (fraction of the length) of the darkness cuts from each end.
Centre of the terminal band of each end, as a fraction of the straightened worm length from the tip.
Binarisation threshold of the Mask2Former masks (values 0 to 255) before extracting the largest connected component.
Minimum mask area (pixels) to process the image, otherwise black thumbnail and worm skipped.
